run.label: referral-moves-manual
run.note: Referral code moves: 12 cases that were declared manual, automated 25-Nov-2026 and run on test.gokesari.com (d418c07b); requests raised for test shops / members are cancelled at once, nothing approved

results.title: Referral moves opens from Admin → Dealers with the new-request card (buttons, disabled Search and Raise request, the dealer's own code first) and lists approved dealers only
results.detail: opens from Dealers; card as designed; “Move to dealer / franchise” lists 5 approved dealers, not GoKesari Direct
results.partial: “No move requests yet.” shows only on a site without requests (staging has earlier ones)
results.test: TC-REFM-001 Referral moves opens from Admin → Dealers with the new-request card (buttons, disabled Search and Raise request, the dealer's own code first) and lists approved dealers only

results.title: the old one-admin transfer API refuses and points to Referral moves; the operator is refused; the team member stays

results.test: TC-REFM-004 the old one-admin transfer API refuses and points to Referral moves; the operator is refused; the team member stays

results.title: Referral moves at 375 px: no sideways scroll for either request kind, the form fields stack and the Requests list stays inside the screen

results.title: find shops: Search waits for 2 characters; a name, an owner's phone or a shop id finds the shop with its team and code; Add builds “Chosen (n)” and a click removes one

results.partial: The phone search is sent to the API (its hits are not matched to one owner); the 50-shop cap on Add is not reached
results.test: TC-REFM-006 find shops: Search waits for 2 characters; a name, an owner's phone or a shop id finds the shop with its team and code; Add builds “Chosen (n)” and a click removes one
